$comment: What a tool made from this template must look like. Read by dlab5-repo-conformance in the d-lab-5 catalogue's dlab5-house; change it in the same PR as the template change it describes. {package_name} and {tool_name} come from the tool's .copier-answers.yml.

require.why: the launcher every tool starts with
the test entry point CI and copier update rely on
the one place the version lives
core-owned: the tool's name, port and version
core-owned: the loopback page and lifecycle endpoints
core-owned: keeps the skill's three copies in step
the packaged copy of the tool's skill

contains.why: ROS puts /opt/ros on PYTHONPATH in every shell and it leaks into the venv

executable.why: ./run.sh is how a person starts the tool
./test.sh is how CI and copier update run the tests

checks.why: the tool's own tests, including the core's
